## What's new in Igggy 0.1.24
- **Igggy opens on Today.** Relaunching while signed in no longer flashes a sign-in button first. Today's meetings show at once if Igggy already read them today, your recent notes come up sooner, and if Google can't be reached Today says so instead of telling you the day is empty. The account menu's Settings item now reads "Account & settings". - **One box for model downloads.** Today and setup show one bar, the time left and one main button. The models Igggy needs can pause and pick up again, even after a quit; optional ones can cancel. With no connection the box waits and restarts on its own, and Igggy checks for room first and says how much it needs. "Downloading" now appears only when files are coming in, and the finished box leaves on its own after a minute, or press OK. Settings → AI Models has a Speech Models section that shows where each one stands. - **Record new note shows its shortcut, and the plus moved.** Hover over Record new note and the tooltip names the key. The Add row in the sidebar is gone. To add notes, use the plus on the Notes row beside the chevron, which appears when you hover over the row. - **⌘N records, ⇧⌘N adds notes.** Those are the keys on a new install. If you already use Igggy, your keys haven't changed, and you can change them in Settings → General. ⇧⌘I still records from any app, even with Igggy in the background, and its row in Settings now says so. - **Add notes is for pasting, Import is for files.** Paste notes, a transcript or a link into Add notes. To bring in files, drop them on the window or use File → Import Files. A sheet lists each item and says what will happen, and anything Igggy can't use stays on the list, grayed, with the reason. Plain Markdown (.md) files now work, and one drop can hold several files or a folder. When a link's page needs a sign-in, Igggy says it can't read the page and suggests pasting the text. - **Settings → Output is now Library.** Import Files lives there too, with a line naming the formats Igggy accepts. - **One menu chooses what writes your notes.** Settings → AI Models has a "Write notes with" menu at the top, and it lists what isn't ready yet, grayed, with the reason. Saving your own API key now checks it, and Igggy asks once per company before your notes go there. Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6.1 Terra join the model lists.
